description:
Multi-use trail; primarily used for mountain biking, e-biking, trail running and hiking during the spring and summer months. This trails difficulty rating is listed as black, singletrack and flows downhill (East to West). Dog friendly trail.

Distance: 921.0 m | Elevation: 10 m | Descent: -203 m
directions:
Access Info:
Starts right off the "4 corners" at the end of WACO.

Can be accessed from Mackenzie FSR (multi-use access/double track).
title: Blood Sweat and Fear
